verdict_basis: The independently generated replay satisfies V0, V1, and V2; both manifests verify; all non-summary replay artifacts are byte-identical to author-attempt-002; the normalized summary differs only by generated_at; six regressions and ten independent adversarial checks pass; and the distinct Rust and Lean evidence routes are honestly mapped to the V0-V2 executable-evaluation capability without a V3 theorem-completeness claim.

findings.title: Attempt-002 repairs the tier-subject binding
findings.evidence: source-bindings.json, all three tier invocations, and both underlying EVF profiles bind the exact current INPUT-CANDIDATE.json bytes. A deliberately wrong subject digest is rejected before receipt construction, and the tier kernel independently rejects subject digest drift.

findings.title: Rust and Lean routes are materially distinct and honestly mapped for V0-V2
findings.evidence: The executable EVF route uses profile auth.completion.executable.v1 and records 64 Rust tests from auth-completion-provider. The theorem EVF route uses profile auth.completion.theorem.v1 and records three Lean 4 typechecker checks from lean4-core-typechecker. The bridge gives them distinct route IDs and independence groups. Both are mapped to executable-evaluation because that is the V0-V2 profile capability for the executable-implementation trait; PLAN.md and PROVIDER-BINDINGS.json explicitly deny any V3 theorem-completeness claim. The shared evf-independent-verifier binary revalidates the two distinct sealed envelopes and is not represented as an additional independent proof route.

findings.title: Independent replay agrees with the sealed author result
findings.evidence: The replay reports pass with verified_tiers V0, V1, V2 and two fresh verifier runs. Twelve non-summary artifacts are byte-identical to author-attempt-002, and RESULT.json is equal after removing generated_at.

findings.title: Manifests and exact source bindings are current
findings.evidence: Both 13-entry ARTIFACTS.sha256 manifests verify. The bound subject, hostile controls, mutation result, tier profile, and 9,708,600-byte verifier binary match their declared SHA-256 values and sizes.

findings.title: Regression and adversarial behavior remains fail closed
findings.evidence: Six repository regressions pass. Ten independent cases reject subject drift, profile drift, duplicate route IDs, duplicate independence groups, false exact-binding claims, a missing V2 control, a surviving duplicate-class control, provider disagreement, and an unbound profile subject; the route-materiality check also passes. Missing V2 evidence reports available_lower_tier V1 but grants no verified tier, so no silent downgrade occurs.

findings.title: V2 controls and the property statement remain within their declared bounds
findings.evidence: The subject, denominator, evidence, and execution classes map to passed hostile observations; the oracle class maps to all six declared behavioral mutants killed for their declared causes with neutral controls passing. The bridge property restates the candidate product contract's fail-closed rule and remains candidate meaning only.
